title: Ordinal Patterns Based Testing of Spatial Independence in Irregular Spatial Structures
summary: We propose a nonparametric test of spatial independence for data observed on irregular, non-lattice point clouds $\mathcal{V}_{n}\subset\mathbb{R}^{2}$. For each location $v\in\mathcal{V}_{n}$, we encode the local spatial configuration through the ordinal pattern of the $m$ nearest-neighbour observations, obtaining a symbolic representation that is invariant under strictly monotone transformations and robust to outliers.
